title: Prompt-Payment Cash Discount — Commercial Credit Account Conditions
content:
**Conditions of the prompt-payment cash discount on the Commercial Credit Account.**

### Clauses in force

1. The payment is received no later than the tier's discount window in calendar days after the invoice date.
2. Counting starts the day after the invoice date; a payment received on the last day of the window qualifies, and a payment received later does not.
3. A tier whose discount window is 0 days offers no discount.
4. A customer who deducts a discount that was not earned has short-paid the invoice and the unpaid amount stays open on the invoice.

The window is measured from the invoice date shown on the invoice in the account's receivable history to the received date recorded on the payment applied to that invoice; the records decide, not the customer's account of when it paid.

### Retired clauses

The following clauses are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

- *No longer in force:* "A payment earns the tier's prompt-payment cash discount percentage on the merchandise subtotal of the invoice it pays, never on freight or sales tax."
- *No longer in force:* "Only payment of the full remaining invoice balance (less the discount) earns the discount, except that on a tier whose partial-payment setting is yes a partial payment inside the window earns the discount pro rata on the merchandise share it pays."
- *No longer in force:* "No discount is earned on an invoice billed under a Contract Pricing Agreement whose tier is listed among the tier's cash-discount-excluded pricing tiers and whose status is active on the invoice date, because those prices are already net."

### Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

On a tier with a 10-day window, for an invoice dated the 3rd of a month:

| Payment received | Inside the window? |
|---|---|
| the 3rd (the invoice date) | yes |
| the 13th (day 10, the last day) | yes |
| the 14th (day 11) | no |

superseded_clauses: A payment earns the tier's cash_discount_pct prompt-payment discount on the merchandise subtotal of the invoice it pays, never on freight or sales tax.

Only payment of the full remaining invoice balance (less the discount) earns the discount, except that on a tier whose cash_discount_partial_payment is true a partial payment inside the window earns the discount pro rata on the merchandise share it pays.

No discount is earned on an invoice billed under a Contract Pricing Agreement whose tier is listed in cash_discount_excluded_pricing_tiers and whose status is active on the invoice date, because those prices are already net.
